bannedCommands: git checkout / git restore / git stash / git clean / git reset on files you did not create
git push (no remote; integration belongs to the orchestrator)
cargo update (versions pinned in Cargo.lock; the set was verified in a probe crate)
projectRules:
- External data never panics: no unwrap/expect outside tests (clippy denies), typed errors with thiserror; the catalog changes without notice and one bad manifest must not kill the TUI.
- Nothing prints to stdout outside src/main.rs and src/cli/; the TUI owns the terminal and a stray println corrupts the screen.
- Windows-only code in *_win.rs behind #[cfg(windows)] mod; never cfg!(windows) inside shared logic, so correlation stays testable with synthetic data.
- Unit/integration tests never touch the network or the real registry; live tests are #[ignore = "live: ..."].
- No new dependency unless the brief lists it; the set was verified together in a probe crate.
- User-facing text in Portuguese; code and comments in English.
- Early threads are joined on every path and worker panics are re-raised with resume_unwind (escaped in tasks 18, 20 and the final review).
- More than one path to the same result needs an equivalence test (search in memory / SQLite / search.idx).
- Third-party files (winget installed.db) are read-only and never opened in WAL mode.
- Measure before optimizing; benchmarks only with -Baseline; revert optimizations without measured gain.
_designTasks: Fase 1: design (opus) = 10 normalizer, 12 correlação, 15 validação, 21 desempates. Nesses o revisor opus achou os defeitos mais caros (MSIX sparse, rastreamento do winget). Transcrição com testes literais rodou bem em sonnet.
_perf: Tarefas que medem tempo rodam sozinhas; bench sempre com -Baseline target/release/examples/noop.exe; A/B contra a base para números decisivos.
